issue_title: Home page performance below threshold: score 80, LCP 4.1 s
issue_body:
# Home page (/) performance regression

## Summary
The home page mobile Lighthouse performance score has dropped to **80** (previous: 84), falling below the 85-point watch threshold. The primary driver is a slow **LCP of 4 124 ms** (up from 3 526 ms in the last successful audit).

## Metrics
| Metric | Previous | Current | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| Performance | 84 | **80** | −4 |
| LCP | 3 526 ms | **4 124 ms** | +598 ms |
| TBT | 211 ms | 238 ms | +27 ms |
| CLS | 0.015 | 0.015 | — |

## Likely causes
- Hero section device-mockup images are not preloaded and/or not in a next-gen format (WebP/AVIF).
- No explicit `width`/`height` on hero images may cause the browser to delay rendering.
- TBT nudging upward suggests heavier JS execution on the critical path.

## Recommended fixes
1. Identify the LCP element (likely the hero image/canvas) and add `<link rel="preload">` for it.
2. Convert hero images to WebP/AVIF and serve via `<picture>` or `srcset`.
3. Add explicit `width` and `height` attributes to all above-the-fold images.
4. Audit third-party scripts loading during page initialisation that contribute to TBT.

## Context
- All other quality dimensions (accessibility 100, best-practices 100, SEO 100) remain perfect.
- /projects/screenshot-to-primevue performance (75) and /projects/note-structurer (79) remain below 85 but are unchanged from prior audits and tracked separately.
